035/**
036 * Central configuration interface for JPanSim2 experiments.
037 *
038 * <p>
039 * This immutable configuration interface defines all parameters needed to run
040 * an experiment in JPanSim2, including:
041 * <ul>
042 * <li>Batch job configurations (via {@link BatchConfiguration})</li>
043 * <li>Setup configurations (via {@link SetupConfiguration} and
044 * {@link SetupFacet})</li>
045 * <li>Execution configurations (via {@link ExecutionConfiguration} and
046 * {@link ExecutionFacet})</li>
047 * <li>Replication counts for both setup and execution phases</li>
048 * </ul>
049 *
050 * <p>
051 * Key features:
052 * <ul>
053 * <li>Supports SLURM parallelisation through batch configuration</li>
054 * <li>Provides methods for generating configuration subsets per batch node</li>
055 * <li>Includes JSON serialisation/deserialisation capabilities</li>
056 * <li>Allows configuration composition through facets and modifications</li>
057 * </ul>
058 *
059 * <p>
060 * Each experiment consists of a set of simulation setups (defined by setup
061 * facets) and a set of execution configurations (defined by execution facets).
062 * The configuration supports generating all combinations of setups and
063 * executions, as well as replicating each configuration multiple times for
064 * statistical robustness. In the end the number of simulations run will be:
065 * <ul>
066 * <li>Number of setups = product of modifications across all setup facets</li>
067 * <li>Number of executions = product of modifications across all execution
068 * facets</li>
069 * <li>Total simulations = setups * executions * setup replications * execution
070 * replications</li>
071 * </ul>
072 * Different setup facets or setup replications will usually be shared between
073 * different SLURM nodes, but the execution configurations and execution
074 * replications will be typically be run in parallel within one node according
075 * to the batch configuration. The optimal SLURM parallelisation will therefore
076 * be to have a node per setup facet * setup replication and then run all
077 * execution facets and execution replications in parallel within each node.
078 *
079 * <p>
080 * Example usage:
081 *
082 * <pre>{@code
083 * ExperimentConfiguration config = ExperimentConfiguration.readConfig(path);
084 * BatchConfiguration batchConfig = config.getBatchConfig();
085 * List<SetupConfiguration> setups = config.getBatchSetupList();
086 * }</pre>
087 *
088 * @author Rob Challen
089 * @see BatchConfiguration
090 * @see SetupConfiguration
091 * @see ExecutionConfiguration
092 */
093@Value.Immutable
094@JsonSerialize(as = ImmutableExperimentConfiguration.class)
095@JsonDeserialize(as = ImmutableExperimentConfiguration.class)
096public interface ExperimentConfiguration extends Abstraction.Described {
097
098        /**
099         * Default immutable configuration instance used when no other configuration
100         * is provided. Includes:
101         * <ul>
102         * <li>Defaults from {@link BatchConfiguration#DEFAULT}</li>
103         * <li>Single setup facet with {@link SetupConfiguration#DEFAULT}</li>
104         * <li>{@link ExecutionConfiguration#DEFAULT}</li>
105         * <li>1 replication for both setup and execution</li>
106         * </ul>
107         */
108        ImmutableExperimentConfiguration DEFAULT = ImmutableExperimentConfiguration
109                .builder()
110                .setBatchConfig(BatchConfiguration.DEFAULT)
111                .setSetupConfig(List.of(SetupFacet.of(SetupConfiguration.DEFAULT)))
112                .setExecutionConfig(ExecutionConfiguration.DEFAULT)
113                .setExecutionReplications(1)
114                .setSetupReplications(1)
115                .build();
116
117        /**
118         * Reads and deserializes an ExperimentConfiguration from a JSON file.
119         * Supports JSON with comments and handles Guava collection types.
120         *
121         * @param file Path to JSON configuration file
122         * @return Deserialized ExperimentConfiguration
123         * @throws StreamWriteException on JSON parsing errors
124         * @throws DatabindException    on data binding issues
125         * @throws IOException          on file system errors
126         * @see #writeConfig(Path, boolean)
127         */
128        static ExperimentConfiguration readConfig(Path file)
129                        throws StreamWriteException, DatabindException, IOException {
130                var om = new ObjectMapper();
131                om.enable(SerializationFeature.INDENT_OUTPUT);
132                om.enable(JsonParser.Feature.ALLOW_COMMENTS);
133                om.registerModules(new GuavaModule());
134                om.setDefaultPropertyInclusion(Include.NON_NULL);
135                // om.setSerializationInclusion(Include.NON_NULL);
136                var rt = (ExperimentConfiguration) om
137                        .readerFor(ExperimentConfiguration.class)
138                        .readValue(file.toFile());
139                return rt;
140        }
141
142        static String getFileVersion() {
143                var myProperties = new Properties();
144                try {
145                        myProperties.load(
146                                ExperimentConfiguration.class
147                                        .getResourceAsStream("/jpansim-version.properties")
148                        );
149                } catch (IOException e) {
150                        throw new IllegalStateException(e);
151                }
152                return (String) myProperties.get("version");
153        }
154
155        default void checkConfigVersion() {
156                var ref = getFileVersion();
157                if (!this.getVersion()
158                        .equalsIgnoreCase(ref))
159                        throw new RuntimeException(
160                                        String.format(
161                                                "Mismatch between configuration version %s and api version %s",
162                                                this.getVersion(),
163                                                ref
164                                        )
165                        );
166        }
167
168        /**
169         * Creates a SimulationExporter configured for this experiment's batch
170         * settings. The exporter will use the batch-specific output directory if
171         * running in a multi-node SLURM batch job.
172         *
173         * @param workingDirectory Root directory for output files
174         * @return Configured SimulationExporter instance
175         * @see #getBatchDirectoryPath(Path)
176         */
177        @JsonIgnore
178        default SimulationExporter exporter(Path workingDirectory) {
179                return SimulationExporter.of(
180                        workingDirectory,
181                        Arrays.stream(
182                                this.getBatchConfig()
183                                        .getExporters()
184                        )
185                                .map(Exporters::getSelector)
186                                .collect(Collectors.toList())
187                );
188        }
189
190        /**
191         * Gets the batch configuration parameters for SLURM job parallelisation.
192         *
193         * @return Immutable batch configuration instance
194         * @see BatchConfiguration
195         */
196        ImmutableBatchConfiguration getBatchConfig();
197
198        /**
199         * Gets the batch-specific output directory path. In multi-node SLURM jobs,
200         * this returns a subdirectory named with the batch number. Otherwise returns
201         * the base directory unchanged.
202         *
203         * @param baseDirectory Root directory for output files
204         * @return Batch-specific output directory path
205         */
206        @JsonIgnore
207        default Path getBatchDirectoryPath(Path baseDirectory) {
208                if (this.getBatchConfig()
209                        .getBatchTotal() <= 1) return baseDirectory;
210                return baseDirectory.resolve(
211                        "" + this.getBatchConfig()
212                                .getBatchNumber()
213                );
214        }
215
216        /**
217         * Gets the batch-specific working directory path. In SLURM jobs this returns
218         * a $LOCALDIR if it exists, this is typically a high performance filesystem.
219         *
220         * @param baseDirectory Root directory for output files
221         * @return Batch-specific output directory path
222         */
223        @JsonIgnore
224        default Path getWorkingBaseDirectory(Path baseDirectory) {
225                if (!this.getBatchConfig()
226                        .getLocalDir()
227                        .equals(BatchConfiguration.NOT_SLURM))
228                        return Paths.get(
229                                this.getBatchConfig()
230                                        .getLocalDir(),
231                                this.getBatchConfig()
232                                        .getSlurmId()
233                        );
234                else
235                        return baseDirectory;
236        }
237
238        /**
239         * Generates a subset of experiment setups relevant to the current SLURM
240         * node. When running in a multi-node SLURM batch job, this method splits the
241         * full setup list into chunks and returns only the portion assigned to this
242         * node.
243         *
244         * @return List of setup configurations for this batch node
245         * @see #getSetup()
246         */
247        @JsonIgnore
248        default List<SetupConfiguration> getBatchSetupList() {
249
250                if (this.getBatchConfig()
251                        .getBatchTotal() <= 1) return this.getSetup();
252
253                var size = this.getSetup()
254                        .size();
255                if (size == 1) return this.getSetup();
256
257                // Handle SLURM parallelisation. Split list into N chunks based on number
258                // of batches
259                var chunkSize = (int) Math.ceil(
260                        ((double) size) / this.getBatchConfig()
261                                .getBatchTotal()
262                );
263
264                // This is going to be made up of a list of setups and replicates.
265                // each replicate is stand alone so we can just filter this list to
266                // get to the list for this node.
267                var start = (this.getBatchConfig()
268                        .getBatchNumber() - 1) * chunkSize;
269                var end = Math.min(
270                        this.getBatchConfig()
271                                .getBatchNumber() * chunkSize,
272                        size
273                );
274                if (start >= size) return Collections.emptyList();
275                return this.getSetup()
276                        .subList(start, end);
277
278        }
279
280        /**
281         * Generates all execution configurations by applying all modifications from
282         * execution facets and expanding replications. This includes:
283         * <ul>
284         * <li>Applying all modifications from execution facets</li>
285         * <li>Generating replicated configurations when replications > 1</li>
286         * <li>Ensuring each configuration has a unique name</li>
287         * </ul>
288         *
289         * @return Complete list of execution configurations with modifications
290         *         applied
291         * @throws RuntimeException if any modification lacks a name
292         */
293        @JsonIgnore
294        default List<ExecutionConfiguration> getExecution() {
295
296                var base = this.getExecutionConfig();
297                List<ImmutableExecutionConfiguration> out = new ArrayList<>();
298                out.add(base);
299                for (ExecutionFacet facet : this.getFacets()) {
300
301                        var facetName = facet.getName();
302                        List<ImmutableExecutionConfiguration> tmp = new ArrayList<>();
303
304                        for (Modification<ExecutionConfiguration> mod : facet
305                                .getModifications()) {
306
307                                if (mod instanceof PartialExecutionConfiguration) {
308
309                                        if (mod.self()
310                                                .getName() == null)
311                                                throw new RuntimeException(
312                                                                "Modifications must have a value for name"
313                                                );
314
315                                        out.forEach(b -> {
316                                                var modified = (ImmutableExecutionConfiguration) ReflectionUtils
317                                                        .merge(b, mod)
318                                                        .withName(
319                                                                (!b.getName()
320                                                                        .equals(base.getName()) ? b.getName() + ":" : "")
321                                                                                + facetName + ":" + mod.self()
322                                                                                        .getName()
323                                                        );
324                                                tmp.add(modified);
325                                        });
326                                }
327                        }
328                        out = tmp;
329
330                }
331
332                List<ExecutionConfiguration> tmp = new ArrayList<>();
333                for (var i = 0; i < this.getExecutionReplications(); i++) {
334                        for (ExecutionConfiguration b : out) {
335                                tmp.add(b.withReplicate(i));
336                        }
337                }
338
339                return tmp;
340
341        }
342
343        /**
344         * Gets the base execution configuration before modifications.
345         *
346         * @return Immutable base execution configuration
347         * @see ExecutionConfiguration
348         */
349        ImmutableExecutionConfiguration getExecutionConfig();
350
351        /**
352         * Gets the number of replications to generate for each execution
353         * configuration.
354         *
355         * @return Number of execution replications (minimum 1)
356         */
357        int getExecutionReplications();
358
359        /**
360         * Gets the list of execution facets containing modifications to apply.
361         * Facets are processed in order with each modification building on previous
362         * results.
363         *
364         * @return List of execution configuration facets
365         * @see ExecutionFacet
366         */
367        List<ExecutionFacet> getFacets();
368
369        /**
370         * Generates all setup configurations by applying all modifications from
371         * setup facets and expanding replications. This includes:
372         * <ul>
373         * <li>Applying all modifications from setup facets</li>
374         * <li>Generating replicated configurations when replications > 1</li>
375         * <li>Ensuring each configuration has a unique name</li>
376         * </ul>
377         *
378         * @return Complete list of setup configurations with modifications applied
379         * @throws RuntimeException if any modification lacks a name
380         */
381        @JsonIgnore
382        default List<SetupConfiguration> getSetup() {
383
384                List<SetupConfiguration> tmp = new ArrayList<>();
385                var setupCfg = this.getSetupConfig();
386
387                for (SetupFacet facet : setupCfg) {
388
389                        var base = facet.getDefault();
390
391                        if (facet.getModifications()
392                                .isEmpty()) {
393                                tmp.add(base);
394                        } else {
395                                for (Modification<? extends SetupConfiguration> mod : facet
396                                        .getModifications()) {
397
398                                        if (mod.self()
399                                                .getName() == null)
400                                                throw new RuntimeException(
401                                                                "Modifications must have a value for name"
402                                                );
403
404                                        SetupConfiguration modified = // ConfigMerger.INSTANCE
405//                                      .mergeConfiguration(
406                                                        ((ImmutableSetupConfiguration) ReflectionUtils
407                                                                .merge(base, mod)).withName(
408                                                                        facet.getDefault()
409                                                                                .getName() + ":"
410                                                                                        + mod.self()
411                                                                                                .getName()
412                                                                );
413
414                                        tmp.add(modified);
415                                }
416                        }
417
418                }
419
420                List<SetupConfiguration> tmp2 = new ArrayList<>();
421                for (var i = 0; i < this.getSetupReplications(); i++) {
422                        for (SetupConfiguration b : tmp) {
423                                tmp2.add(((ImmutableSetupConfiguration) b).withReplicate(i));
424                        }
425                }
426
427                return tmp2;
428
429        }

447        @Value.Default
448        default String getVersion() { return getFileVersion(); }

450        /**
451         * Creates a new configuration with the specified execution configuration.
452         *
453         * @param config The new execution configuration to use
454         * @return New ExperimentConfiguration instance
455         */
456        default ImmutableExperimentConfiguration withExecutionConfig(
457                        ImmutableExecutionConfiguration config
458        ) {
459                return ImmutableExperimentConfiguration.builder()
460                        .from(this)
461                        .setExecutionConfig(config)
462                        .build();
463        }
464
465        /**
466         * Creates a new configuration with an additional execution facet containing
467         * the specified modifications. The facet will be named with the provided
468         * name parameter.
469         *
470         * @param name   Name for the new execution facet
471         * @param config Modifications to include in the new facet
472         * @return New ExperimentConfiguration instance
473         */
474        default ImmutableExperimentConfiguration withFacet(
475                        String name, PartialExecutionConfiguration... config
476        ) {
477                return ImmutableExperimentConfiguration.builder()
478                        .from(this)
479                        .addFacets(
480                                ImmutableExecutionFacet.builder()
481                                        .setName(name)
482                                        .setModifications(Arrays.asList(config))
483                                        .build()
484                        )
485                        .build();
486        }
487
488        /**
489         * Creates a new configuration with the specified setup configuration.
490         * Replaces any existing setup configurations with a single facet containing
491         * the provided configuration as its default.
492         *
493         * @param config The new setup configuration to use
494         * @return New ExperimentConfiguration instance
495         */
496        default ImmutableExperimentConfiguration withSetupConfig(
497                        SetupConfiguration config
498        ) {
499                return ImmutableExperimentConfiguration.builder()
500                        .from(this)
501                        .setSetupConfig(
502                                List.of(
503                                        ImmutableSetupFacet.builder()
504                                                .setDefault(config)
505                                                .build()
506                                )
507                        )
508                        .build();
509        }
510
511        /**
512         * Serializes this configuration to JSON and writes it to the specified path.
513         * If the path doesn't end with '.json', creates a 'config.json' file in the
514         * specified directory. Creates parent directories if needed.
515         *
516         * @param directoryOrFile Path to directory or file for output
517         * @param overwrite       If true, overwrites existing file; otherwise,
518         *                        throws an exception if the file already exists
519         * @throws StreamWriteException on JSON serialization errors
520         * @throws DatabindException    on data binding issues
521         * @throws IOException          on file system errors
522         * @see #readConfig(Path)
523         */
524        default void writeConfig(Path directoryOrFile, boolean overwrite)
525                        throws StreamWriteException, DatabindException, IOException {
526                var om = new ObjectMapper();
527                om.enable(SerializationFeature.INDENT_OUTPUT);
528                om.registerModules(new GuavaModule());
529                om.setDefaultPropertyInclusion(Include.NON_NULL);
530                // om.setSerializationInclusion(Include.NON_NULL);
531                if (!directoryOrFile.toString()
532                        .endsWith(".json")) {
533                        directoryOrFile = directoryOrFile.resolve("config.json");
534                }
535                Files.createDirectories(directoryOrFile.getParent());
536                if (overwrite) { Files.deleteIfExists(directoryOrFile); }
537                om.writeValue(directoryOrFile.toFile(), this);
538        }
539}
